source.name: Market Rate System (MRS)
source.publisher: Finance Department, Government of the Punjab
source.notes: Machine-extracted with pdfplumber from the official text PDFs (no OCR). Rates for 3943 schedule items (chapters 3-27; chapter 1 'Carriage' omitted because its units are lead-distance per load, which do not fit the unit set, and chapter 2 'Loading, Unloading & Stacking' omitted because its table layout did not extract reliably) plus the Lahore column of the 2nd Bi-Annual 2026 input-rate books for materials (MAT-), labour (LB-) and equipment (EQ-). Schedule items: unit_as_printed/rate_as_printed are the British-system unit and composite rate as printed; rate_pkr is the book's own printed metric-system composite rate (divided by the quantity in the metric unit, e.g. '100 Nos.'). Where the composite column is '--' the labour rate is used and kind='labour'. Every row with both systems printed was cross-checked (British rate converted with 1 cft=0.0283168 m3, 1 sft=0.092903 m2, 1 rft=0.3048 m) against the printed metric rate; rows disagreeing by more than 5% (about 20, mostly misprinted metric rates in the book) were dropped, as were rows whose unit is outside the allowed set (per km, per acre, per bag, per inch, etc.). 'Per Ton' as printed is mapped to t (the book does not say whether long or metric ton). Input-rate units: maund converted at 37.3242 kg. Codes are MRS-<chapter>-<Sr.No.>-<sub-item markers> built from the book's own numbering; '#n' disambiguates rows whose printed numbering repeats. About 90 rate rows printed without their own sub-item number under an already-priced line were left out because their description could not be attributed reliably. District Lahore only; other districts are separate PDFs on the same page.
